question: Should AG-UI be supported and maintained as a bundled OpenClaw channel with its AG-UI runtime dependencies in the shipped distribution?
rationale: The branch introduces a new protocol, authentication, distribution, and dependency-ownership surface; this is a product and supply-chain decision, not a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled channel
options.body: Accept AG-UI as a bundled channel and authorize the reviewed dependency graph after normal security and integration checks pass.

options.title: Pause for an external-channel direction
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers define a supported external-channel activation and packaging model that can carry this capability without adding bespoke core behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bundled channel
recommendation.body: Accept AG-UI as a bundled channel and authorize the reviewed dependency graph after normal security and integration checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion and latest packaging commits directly address the bundled-versus-external distribution boundary.
